sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Which procurement portals to search. SAM.gov needs your own free API key (below).

keywords.title: Keywords (any match)
keywords.description: Keep notices whose title, description or buyer contains any of these words. Leave empty for all.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Drop notices containing any of these words.

cpvPrefixes.title: CPV code prefixes (EU/UK)
cpvPrefixes.description: e.g. 72 (IT services), 4800 (software packages), 45 (construction). A notice matches if any CPV or NAICS filter matches.

countries.title: Buyer countries (ISO-2)
countries.description: e.g. DE, FR, GB, US. Leave empty for all.

minValue.title: Minimum estimated value
minValue.description: In the notice's own currency. Notices without a published value are kept.

lookbackDays.title: Look back (days)
lookbackDays.description: How far back to search on each run. 3 is plenty for a daily schedule.

onlyChanges.title: Only new or changed notices
onlyChanges.description: Skip notices this watch already returned unchanged. Turn off to get everything in the window. You are only charged for notices returned.

watchName.title: Watch name
watchName.description: Separate watches (e.g. 'it-germany', 'construction-uk') each remember what they already sent you.

samApiKey.title: SAM.gov API key
samApiKey.description: Free personal key from api.data.gov / your SAM.gov account. Only needed when 'US – SAM.gov' is selected.
